_note: These are widely published national helpline numbers issued by the Government of India and MUST be verified against official Government of India sources before any production deployment.

contacts.label: Emergency Response (all-in-one)
contacts.note: Single emergency number for police, fire, ambulance and disaster response.
contacts.source: National Emergency Response Programme, Ministry of Home Affairs

contacts.label: Police
contacts.note: Law enforcement emergencies and police assistance.
contacts.source: National Police Helpline, Ministry of Home Affairs

contacts.label: Ambulance
contacts.note: Emergency medical assistance and ambulance dispatch.
contacts.source: Emergency Ambulance Services, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

contacts.label: Emergency medical (rural/remote)
contacts.note: Ambulance services for rural and remote areas.
contacts.source: Emergency Ambulance Services, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

contacts.label: Women helpline
contacts.note: Support for women in distress, available in many languages.
contacts.source: Women Helpline, Ministry of Women and Child Development

contacts.label: Women domestic violence helpline
contacts.note: Dedicated helpline for women facing domestic violence.
contacts.source: Women Helpline, Ministry of Women and Child Development

contacts.label: Childline (child protection)
contacts.note: 24-hour emergency support for children in distress.
contacts.source: Childline India Foundation, Ministry of Women and Child Development

contacts.label: Cyber Financial Fraud helpline
contacts.note: Report cyber financial fraud such as online scams.
contacts.source: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal, Ministry of Home Affairs

contacts.label: Elderline (senior citizen support)
contacts.note: Helpline for senior citizens needing care, guidance or emotional support.
contacts.source: Elderline, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
